Strategic bidding near but not exactly at my value makes sense. Since other bidders' values are unknown, I'll bid close to my value but slightly under to maximize potential profit margin. I'll bid $22.9 to increase chances of winning while preserving some profit potential.

A bid near my value but not exactly at it allows room for potential profit if I win. Given the second-price auction mechanism, I'll bid around $16.50 - high enough to likely win, but leaving a small margin of potential profit if the second-highest bid is low.
